result.summary: Я написал проект исправления: новая проверка findSecrets ищет настоящие секреты по девяти формам, файл результата хранится точно как его написал агент, а файл с настоящим секретом ядро не принимает и честно говорит об этом словом «секрет» (его исходник тоже удаляется из рабочей папки). issues.text: The requirement's table of guard tests is incomplete (AP-111, AP-123). It names eight tests (decision 0102 item 4: 'eight, not five'), taken from a mutant that removes masking. The design applied as a sketch turns TWELVE red: SF-10, SF-11, SF-12 and SF-15 of tools/test/team-engine-rounds.test.js too, because the shared helper twoRounds (line 68) puts a key bait into the round-1 file of every test that uses it, and the new core refuses that file. Measured: 548 pass on the tag, 536 pass and 12 fail on the sketch; with the bait line replaced only SF-13 stays red. Design section 7 and micro-amendment F (section 12) take all twelve. See O1.

Criterion 5 expects the word 'секрет' in the output of 'team project <id>' from the key FAIL_DETAIL.secret. Measured: the project view shows the phrase of the LAST event of the task; on the engine path that is a CHAT question ('Команда задала вам вопрос'), the failure text is in chat[].text; after run-task the phrase is the PHRASES row, not the detail. The design adds a PHRASES row conditional on the detail (TM-38 and TM-40 stay green, measured) and rewrites the sentence of criterion 5 (micro-amendment A, exact old and new text).

O1 (needs an ORCH answer before the design gate). Twelve guard tests, not eight: micro-amendment F of section 12 (REQ-ANALYST then REQ-VALIDATOR) and an addition to decisions/0102 item 4 or to the new record. Default: the design already treats all twelve as the tests expected red between steps 4 and 6; without the amendment criterion 9(a) counts 20 and does not name four tests that the work must change.

O2 (needs ORCH and, by decisions/0102 item 19, the owner). Text after the first value in the same line is not examined (old M2 hid the rest of an Authorization line; old M9 hid text glued after a comma). Refusing it would refuse the plan seed O6 itself ({ token: data.token, user: x }) and every headers object. Proposal: name it as residual risk (6) (micro-amendment D) and add it to the closed questions of decisions/0102 item 22. Default: named, not refused. The white-space variants (no-break space, em space, form feed, vertical tab) are REFUSED (micro-amendment C): no owner needed.

O3. Old-core files carry the mark [скрыто]: 'password=[скрыто]', 'token: [скрыто]', 'Authorization: [скрыто]', 'https://u:[скрыто]@h/x' are refused by the new forms (measured). Decision of the design for finding F4 of the gate: depsOf scans and WITHHOLDS such a file (constant text FILE_WITHHELD, no exception, nothing written; micro-amendment E adds part (г) to criterion 2 and mutants m22, m23). Alternative for ORCH or the owner: count a value that starts with the mark as a seventh kept class (a requirement change; not applied). Default: withhold.

O4. Proposal for a decisions/ record (Q12): 0103 'Result files: byte-exact storage, findSecrets, refusal of a real secret (REQ-102)', content in section 14 (it must carry the phrases that criterion 11(b) greps, the three quotations of 0017 P9 and 0035 that it replaces, M7 and M10, the placeholder list, the false-refusal prices, the scripted exclusion, the answer to the expression question of decisions/0102 item 22, the twelve tests, residual risk (6), the depsOf withholding, the BOM decision). ORCH gives the number and accepts it; alternatively an Addition 6 to 0102 (then the grep -v of criterion 11(b) changes).

Between steps 4 and 6 these 12 tests of the tag are red by the design (section 7 of docs/design/REQ-102-result-files-byte-exact.md; new expected behaviour in its was->became table): TM-57 (tools/test/team-store.test.js:499), TM-58 (:757), TM-63 (:1006), RF-03 (tools/test/team-engine-reads-files.test.js:134), SF-10 (tools/test/team-engine-rounds.test.js:111), SF-11 (:144), SF-12 (:182), SF-13 (:234), SF-15 (:369), TM-43 (tools/test/team-journal.test.js:450), EX-41 (tools/test/exec-workdir.test.js:35), EX-51 (tools/test/exec-scripted-source.test.js:71).

Two things found by the sketch that no criterion has: (1) a regular expression with a repeated group over a 4 MiB path value overflows the stack (RangeError) and a text-wide indexOf for the end of line makes the template-group search quadratic (family 8: 52 / 653 / 2587 ms at 256 KiB / 1 MiB / 2 MiB). The design forbids both and adds family 10 to criterion 7 and mutants m28, m30 (micro-amendment G, H). (2) Decoder of scenario bytes: strictUtf8 in store.js must NOT get ignoreBOM, a scenario with a BOM is accepted today and no old test pins it; the design splits a new resultUtf8 and adds a guard test (RB-02, mutant m25).

Cost of the rule on a real tree (named, not hidden): findSecrets over the text files of the tag refuses 1 of 150 files of tools/src (pixel-office/mask.js, because it holds the PEM marker text; the new mask.js will hold it too), 22 of 398 files of tools/test (bait fixtures and masking tests) and 13 of 290 files of docs (quotations of samples). A generated file about PEM or key formats is refused as a secret; this is the price already named in the requirement ('код и текст о заголовках PEM').

Q13, two entries for docs/anti-patterns.md (text for DOC-UPDATER, besides the two of the diagnosis I13): (a) 'The table of guard tests was taken from a mutant that REMOVES a feature; a design that changes the behaviour (here: a refusal instead of a mark) turns red more tests (SF-10/11/12/15 through one shared helper). The table is checked with the new design applied as a sketch, not only with a mutant.' (b) 'A regular expression with a repeated group over the text of a file overflows the stack (RangeError at about 1 million repeats), and indexOf for a character that is absent is searched to the end for each call: both make a pure scan unsafe; use one forward pass.'

Process notes. The tag lacks docs/program/, the design drafts and decisions 0091-0102 (read from the working tree; diagnosis I14 d). docs/requirements.yaml in the working tree carries four status lines of other runs (REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-061; gate note): the final commit of this run must not take them. The Pixel Office and picker test files that mention the default ports 4780-4790 were not run (forbidden); they do not call the team core, and the mask.js rules they pin are not edited (HK-21 by name: 1 of 1 pass). The full npm run check was not run. No file of the project was changed except this handoff and the design file.
